description: Verifies the lock-free command path under load: one hundred thousand commands of eight different kinds are injected by a producer thread while a simulation thread drains the queue and advances the scheduler, and every command is processed with the scheduler making progress and the injected parameters staying in their injected ranges.

checks.label: the simulation worker drains the queue within ten seconds of the end of production
every injected command is processed exactly once
the scheduler advances while commands are being injected
the final mass equals one of the injected values in [1, 2)
